tools.name: bachwknd.cities.list
tools.description: Curated cities with pre-loaded spots. Use geo in later calls.

tools.name: bachwknd.destinations.search
tools.description: Search any city or destination worldwide (curated or geocoded). Use the returned geo in bachwknd.party.create.

tools.name: bachwknd.places.search
tools.description: Search the public directory for spots in one city. Use the returned id in bachwknd.plan.set.

tools.name: bachwknd.parties.list
tools.description: List all parties the signed-in host created or belongs to, with site URLs.

tools.name: bachwknd.party.create
tools.description: Create the weekend and its website for the signed-in host. Returns the site URL.

tools.name: bachwknd.party.get
tools.description: The weekend, its itinerary, costs, crew invites, and website URLs. Pass partyId or slug.

tools.name: bachwknd.party.update
tools.description: Update the weekend title, dates, description, or housing (locationName, link, notes, price) on the website.

tools.name: bachwknd.plan.set
tools.description: Add spots to the itinerary. Each stop needs a place id from search, a day label, and a startsAt time.

tools.name: bachwknd.plan.remove
tools.description: Take one spot off the itinerary.

tools.name: bachwknd.costs.add
tools.description: Add a shared cost / expense to the party budget.

tools.name: bachwknd.costs.remove
tools.description: Remove a shared cost from the party budget.

tools.name: bachwknd.invites.add
tools.description: Invite the crew. Each person gets a private invite link on the website.

tools.name: bachwknd.invites.remove
tools.description: Remove an invited guest from the party by inviteId or email.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bachwknd.parties.list, bachwknd.party.get · Private data: bachwknd.invites.add · Public sink: bachwknd.invites.remove · Destructive: bachwknd.party.delete, bachwknd.plan.remove, bachwknd.costs.remove, bachwknd.invites.remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bachwknd.parties.list, bachwknd.party.get · Private data: bachwknd.invites.add · Public sink: bachwknd.invites.remove · Destructive: bachwknd.party.delete, bachwknd.plan.remove, bachwknd.costs.remove, bachwknd.invites.remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
